study_identification_part.si_4_title: Improving the predictive potential of diffusion MRI in schizophrenia using normative models - Towards subject-level classification

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The dataset was collated from 13 different sites across a number of separate studies. This is the same dataset as described in Cetin-Karayumak et al. (2020). No specific dataset name is provided; data were harmonized multi-site diffusion MRI data from 13 sites. The paper mentions Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC) as one of the data sources in the ethics section.

answer.MULTI-SITE (N>=2): normative model construction (healthy controls) and clinical evaluation (schizophrenia patients)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy controls (N=512) were used to construct the normative model representing the distribution of the normative range in each ROI. Individuals diagnosed with schizophrenia (N=601) were evaluated for deviation from the normative model. The normative model was trained with leave-one-out cross-validation on healthy controls, and z-scores were calculated for both groups. Classification was performed using 10-fold cross-validation.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The normative model represents the distribution of the normative range within each ROI in the healthy controls using the sample mean and standard deviation... The data were partitioned into 10 subsets... In each cross-validation round, one of the 10 subsets served as the test set, while the other 9 subsets served as the training set for the binary classifier.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Elad2021.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / 2.3 Construction of a normative model, L72-73; 2.8 Prediction models, L139

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The study used 512 healthy controls total for the normative model. In the 10-fold cross-validation, training sets consisted of 9 folds (approximately 461 controls: seven subsets of 51 and two subsets of 52 controls). The exact train/test split varied per fold: seven subsets had 51 controls, two had 52 controls, and one had 51 controls. The normative range was estimated using only healthy control subjects in each training set.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: 512 healthy controls (mean [SD] age, 30.15 [14.26] years; 279 [54.49%] male)... The data were partitioned into 10 subsets - seven subsets comprised of 51 subjects from the control group and 60 subjects from the schizophrenia group, two subsets comprised of 52 subjects from the control group and 60 subjects from the schizophrenia group, and one subset comprised of 51 subjects from the control group and 61 subjects from the schizophrenia group.
